sentences.text: Accordingly, the accused entered inside the house and saw her.
When she asked him to go out, the accused caught hold her, slapped on her face, and kicked on her abdomen.

The further allegation is that the accused again kicked on her stomach and twisted her right hand and thereafter, the accused taken her to the bed room ignoring her resistance and subjected her to sexual intercourse.
Hence it is alleged that the accused committed the offence 4.
Heard counsel for the petitioner and the Public Prosecutor.
I also heard the counsel for the defacto complainant.
5. The counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is in custody from 02.01.2024 and he is ready to abide any conditions if this Court grant him bail.
The counsel also submitted that the petitioner is aged only 18 years and he is ready to go to the Police Station everyday if this Court grant him bail.
The counsel for the defacto complainant and the Public Prosecutor seriously opposed the bail application.

The counsel for the defacto complainant submitted that the mother of the petitioner trespassed to the house of the victim and 2025:KER:20018 BAIL APPL. NO. 2312 OF 2025 threatened the victim and others.
Another case is registered against the mother.
That is why this Court rejected the bail application of the petitioner earlier, which was confirmed by the Supreme Court also.
The counsel for the defacto complainant submitted that the petitioner may not be released on bail as there is threat to the life of the victim and her relatives from the petitioner and his family.
6. This Court considered the contentions of the petitioner, Public Prosecutor and the defacto complainant.
This Court directed the Registry to get a report about the present stage of the case.

A report is submitted by the Additional District & Sessions Judge, which is extracted hereunder:
"In compliance with the directions received as per the reference cited, I respectfully submit the following for your kind consideration:

I may humbly submit that a direction has already been issued by the Hon'ble High Court of Kerala to dispose of SC No. 652/2024 within a period of five months from the date of receipt of the Forensic Science Laboratory Report.
The said report was received on 29th December 2025:KER:20018 BAIL APPL. NO. 2312 OF 2025 2024.
Subsequently, on 22nd January 2025, after hearing both parties, charges was framed against the accused.
Due to the pre-scheduled trials for other cases with specific time limit directions, this case has been scheduled for trial from 15th March 2025 to 26th March 2025.
There are 47 witnesses from the prosecution's side, and it is expected that the trial can be completed within the stipulated time frame, which expires on 29th May 2025.
This report is submitted for kind consideration and favourable action."

7. After hearing both sides, I am of the considered opinion that the petitioner can file a bail application before the trial court after examination of CWs. 1 to 3, who are 2025:KER:20018 BAIL APPL. NO. 2312 OF 2025 the main witnesses in this case.
